payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over prefix lengths, track sum and min costs for even/odd indices. For each i, candidate cost = prefix_sum + min_even*(n - cnt_even) + min_odd*(n - cnt_odd). This greedily assigns all remaining distance to the cheapest segment in each direction.
payload.rationale: The algorithm fixes a prefix of segments, assigns length 1 to each, then allocates leftover horizontal/vertical distance entirely to the cheapest segment in that direction. This greedy choice is optimal by an exchange argument: transferring length to a cheaper segment never increases cost. Trying all prefixes finds the best number of segments.
